notablePrerequisites:
Yenna does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one Aura.
description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of an Aura you control, then untapping Yenna and causing you to scry 2.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Aura token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
